scheme_name: Use of Advanced Drone Technology (Agriculture Aircraft) in Agriculture Sector
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a land holder.
Beneficiary must own at least 1 acre of agricultural land.
Beneficiary must have a bank account (bank passbook and cancelled cheque).
Beneficiary must have an Aadhar card as identity proof.
Beneficiary must possess a certified bill of purchase for the equipment/items.
benefits_summary: Provides 90% financial assistance up to ₹500 per acre per spraying, with a maximum benefit for five acres per account.
documents_required: Certified bill of purchase of equipment/items
